title: pvOutlineCurvilinearDataSet
body:
## pvOutlineCurvilinearDataSet

Draws the 12 boundary edges of a structured (curvilinear) grid as polydata lines that follow the grid's curved outer edges instead of its axis-aligned bounding box. Input must be a vtkStructuredGrid. Use it to show the extent of a body-fitted CFD block; outline or pvOutline draw a bounding-box outline of any dataset.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Unstructured or image inputs are rejected; for those use outline.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `OutlineCurvilinearDataSet`. Identity: `filters/StructuredGridOutlineFilter`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the outline (curvilinear) filter. Accepted data: curvilinear structured grids (vtkStructuredGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkStructuredGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
